parameters.name: ExecutorIds
parameters.description: The list of executor IDs. A maximum of 100 IDs are supported.

parameters.name: JobScheduler
parameters.description:
The type of the job scheduler.

*   HPC
*   K8S

Default value: HPC

parameters.name: JobSpec
parameters.description: The information about the job to be deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpcinstant delete-jobs --job-spec '[{"TaskSpec":[{"TaskName":"task0","ArrayIndex":[1]}],"JobId":"job-xxxx"}]' --executor-ids job-xxxx-Task0-1 --job-scheduler HPC --region cn-hangzhou
